create.name: Zac Carpenter
create.bio:
Zac Carpenter is a reader and energy worker based in Tunbridge Wells, Kent, who trades as Healing With Zac. Before this became his full-time work he acted on stage and in commercials, then moved behind the scenes into casting, voiceover sessions, television development and theatre production. Over roughly eight years of practice he trained in Reiki to master-teacher level, in homeopathy and in tarot, and slowly began combining them with numerology and ideas drawn from archetypal psychology.

The result is a method he calls Energy Mapping, which uses a person's birth date and the twenty-two cards of the tarot's Major Arcana to chart recurring themes in relationships, work and money and the timing of different stretches of life. He reads these maps in recorded video answers or in live sessions of an hour or ninety minutes, online or at his practice, and keeps a strand of private work for actors, musicians and other creative people. Anyone can generate a basic map free on his site, and a paid membership opens the full version with a life timeline and notes. He offers readings as a second pair of eyes rather than a forecast. On Insight Timer he has courses including one on reading the Akashic records, alongside Reiki sessions, sound baths and piano pieces.

courses.title: Live Energy Reading
courses.description: A one-to-one session of 60 or 90 minutes, online or in person in Tunbridge Wells, where Zac reads your Energy Map with you and follows your question as it unfolds. The session can include Reiki, and prepaid packages of five or ten readings are available.

courses.title: Recorded Energy Reading
courses.description: Send one question and Zac looks at it through your Energy Map, tarot and his other tools, then sends back a private video to watch in your own time. No call is needed.

courses.title: Energy Mapping Membership
courses.description: Opens the full version of your birth-date map, with more than forty positions, a year-by-year life timeline, pattern combinations, saved maps and private notes. It is designed to be returned to as new questions come up.
courses.price: £7.99 GBP a month or £79 GBP a year

courses.title: Readings for Talent and Creative People
courses.description: Private ninety-minute readings for actors, recording artists, producers and other creatives, drawing on his own years in casting and production. Sessions look at strengths, direction and the choices in front of you.

courses.title: Become An Akashic Records Reader
courses.description: An eleven-day Insight Timer course of short daily lessons on what the Akashic records are and how to approach them. It includes a guided journey to the records, a session on reading for another person and advice on grounding.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Zac Carpenter on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided Reiki sessions, sound baths, short talks and ambient piano, plus several courses on energy work. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Free Energy Map
free_resources.description: An instant, automated map generated from your birth date, showing three personal attributes and the themes of your current and previous year. Zac does not read it personally; it is a starting point for his method.
